title: Publish candidate release v0.5.66
outOfScope: Changing, deleting, moving, or republishing any existing immutable tag or public Release.
Changing product/runtime source, installer behavior, release workflow logic, security gates, or coverage policy.
Manually creating or moving a tag, GitHub Release, or public release asset outside .github/workflows/release.yml.

Changing unrelated Work Item evidence or user-owned worktree changes.

acceptance: Synchronized origin/main readiness proves v0.5.66 is the only eligible next candidate and the candidate metadata is internally consistent.
A successful same-SHA release.yml rehearsal exists before publication and creates no tag, Release, or public asset.
The actual release.yml workflow publishes immutable v0.5.66 from the final origin/main SHA only after consuming the matching rehearsal receipt and all exact-source gates pass.
Provider-bound release assets include release.json, release-digests.json, SBOM, provenance, CI release evidence, and the source archive with matching digests.
A fresh temporary repository installs from the public full HTTPS template URL at v0.5.66 and verifies version, canonical asset hydration, and distribution consistency.
The Work Item emits a complete direct Outcome beginning with the canonical traffic-light marker, archives only after green completion, and completes PR/merge/ai-close-work-item lifecycle.

guidelines: Use only the authoritative release workflow for immutable provider mutations; do not create tags or Releases manually.
Preserve strict readiness → same-SHA rehearsal → actual publication → post-publication distribution verification ordering.
Do not weaken coverage, test collection, security, smoke, compatibility, release, or evidence gates.
Treat Outcome as the user-facing operation interface and deliver the complete traffic-light report directly in the conversation before archive.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized publishing a new version after the existing goals are complete; external publication remains limited to the authoritative release workflow and its exact-source gates.

rollbackNote: If any release gate fails, do not publish or alter an immutable tag; retain the failure evidence and repair through a corrective Work Item.

intent.problem: The corrective Work Item is complete and merged, while the repository's v0.5.66 candidate remains unpublished; future adopter projects cannot receive the completed release until exact-source provider publication and fresh public installation verification succeed.
constraints: Start from the synchronized origin/main merge commit 44b87df25fc20ce53254c177aa63ff959afb2ca2.
Publish only v0.5.66 through .github/workflows/release.yml after a matching same-SHA rehearsal; never manually create, move, delete, or republish tags or Releases.
Do not claim publication, adopter delivery, or release readiness from local files or chat; require provider-bound assets and fresh HTTPS installation evidence.
If publication fails, preserve the failure evidence and do not mutate the immutable tag or conceal the failure with a green Outcome.
intent.rationale: A new version is only useful to future adopters when the immutable provider tag, source commit, assets, evidence, and real public installation all agree. The authoritative workflow provides the required fail-closed identity boundary.
